Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring department of social and health services to work with community-based and faith-based social services organizations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to communitybased and faithbased social servicesorganizations; and adding a new section to chapter 43.20A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.20A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The secretary will designate a person within each of thedepartment's administrative regions to serve as a liaison forcommunitybased and faithbased social services organizations. Theliaison will be available to such organizations to: (a) Provide information to communitybased and faithbased socialservices organizations that relates to opportunities for theorganizations to cooperate with the department in providing communityservices throughout the state; (b) Identify areas of need that are not currently being met in thestate in which communitybased and faithbased social servicesorganizations may provide needed services; (c) Coordinate efforts to promote involvement of communitybasedand faithbased social services organizations to provide communityservices throughout the state. p. 1 HB 1464 (2) The department must achieve the purposes of this sectionthrough existing resources.
